must_detect_if_evidence_present.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's required_conflicts AND B2 arbitration recorded >= 1 stance-confirmed supporting claim on EACH side (bull_supporting_evidence_count and bear_supporting_evidence_count from conflicts.json's own arbitration.candidate_evaluations[].admissibility)
must_detect_if_evidence_present.evidence_requirement: >= 1 supporting claim per side (weaker than B2's own admission threshold of 2 -- this rule asks 'was evidence present at all', not 'did it clear B2's admission bar')

should_detect_if_supported.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's conditional_conflicts AND evidence is present per the same bar as must_detect_if_evidence_present AND stance_source is llm_semantic or mixed (evaluator.stance_source) -- offline runs with deterministic-baseline-only stance cannot reliably judge 'supported' and are marked pending_review instead
should_detect_if_supported.evidence_requirement: evidence present (>= 1 supporting claim per side) AND LLM-semantic stance resolution actually ran for this replay

conditional_only.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's conditional_conflicts
conditional_only.evidence_requirement: none required to trigger; a miss is always informational, never a fail

do_not_force.applicable_target: every admitted conflict, per ticker (a run-wide invariant, not a per-pair rule)
do_not_force.trigger_condition: always evaluated when the ticker is evaluable
do_not_force.evidence_requirement: every pair in evaluate_ticker's admitted_conflicts must have a matching arbitration.candidate_evaluations entry whose own admissibility.status is 'admitted' -- proves B2's evidence gate was not bypassed, never a second judgment call

allowed_main_conflicts.trigger_condition: pair is in the ticker's allowed_conflicts
allowed_main_conflicts.evidence_requirement: none -- legal structures, never mandatory outputs; absence is never a failure

forbidden_dominant_without_strong_eviden.trigger_condition: Alpha is listed in the ticker's should_not_be_dominant_without_strong_evidence AND reached dominant/regime_level status
forbidden_dominant_without_strong_eviden.evidence_requirement: none to trigger the flag itself -- flags for human review, never auto-fails

should_detect_if_supported.detail: evidence below the evidence-present bar -- rule does not trigger
evidence below the evidence-present bar -- rule does not trigger

do_not_force.detail: every conflicts.json-admitted pair has a matching B2-admitted arbitration entry

structural_expectation_results.note: informational only -- a structural Alpha's absence in any one run never fails that run
